create.name: Udbodhan - Ramakrishna Math Baghbazar
create.bio:
Udbodhan is the branch of the Ramakrishna Math in Baghbazar, north Kolkata, and devotees know its house on Udbodhan Lane as Mayer Bari, the Holy Mother's House. Swami Saradananda, a close companion of Sri Ramakrishna, had it built near the Ganga so that Sri Sarada Devi would have a settled home in the city; she moved in on 23 May 1909 and spent much of her remaining life there, and he wrote his biography of Ramakrishna, the Lilaprasanga, in a small room downstairs. Her shrine room is still worshipped daily, and the house keeps a calendar of festivals including Durga, Kali and Saraswati Puja, Shivaratri and Christmas Eve, with readings from scripture on three evenings a week.

Udbodhan is also the Bengali publishing arm of the Ramakrishna Order. It brings out Udbodhan Patrika, a monthly founded by Swami Vivekananda in 1899 and still in print, together with a large list of Bengali books on the Ramakrishna and Vivekananda tradition, some of which can be read online. Its Bengali-language YouTube channel, active since 2014, carries talks by monks of the Order, serialised audiobooks such as Vivekananda's Jnana Yoga, devotional songs and short explanations of the festivals.
